scenarios.name: Normal Traffic Flow
scenarios.description: Baseline off-peak urban condition. All roads are open and traffic levels are LOW across the entire network.

scenarios.name: Peak Hour Arterial Congestion
scenarios.description: Rush hour surge causes heavy congestion on central arterial roads (R01, R03) and northern expressway (R08). Routing engine must dynamically seek perimeter bypass routes.

scenarios.name: Emergency Incident & Road Closure
scenarios.description: A major construction emergency completely BLOCKS East Express Corridor (R03) while Central-North Arterial (R01) suffers SEVERE congestion. Dynamic routing must instantly isolate the failed link and divert all traffic through southern/market arterials.
